tools.name: clockify_get_config
tools.description: Returns the effective .clockify/config.yml standards (per-method description, task, rounding, overlap, automation). Pass config_root as that repo's git toplevel when this MCP is user-scoped.

config_root.description: Absolute git toplevel of the repo that contains .clockify/config.yml. Resolve once per session with `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` from the working directory (open tabs are not required); reuse that string on later calls unless the repo or focused root changed. Do not pass a multi-root .code-workspace folder.

tools.name: clockify_start_timer
tools.description: Starts a new running timer. Optional start (ISO-8601) backdates the timer; omit for now. entry_method selects timer vs automated config (include_seconds, start rounding, overlap). Prefer stopping any existing timer first. When description.from is template, pass issue_number/issue_title/label if description is omitted. For Cursor Plan/Debug automation, pass cursor_mode so description resolves from platforms.cursor.modes.<mode>. Pass config_root as that repo's git toplevel when this MCP is user-scoped.

config_root.description: Absolute git toplevel of the repo that contains .clockify/config.yml. Resolve once per session with `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` from the working directory (open tabs are not required); reuse that string on later calls unless the repo or focused root changed. Do not pass a multi-root .code-workspace folder.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID. Defaults to scope.workspace_id from config.yml (required pin). Never the Clockify UI active workspace.

start.description: ISO-8601 start. Omit to start now. Used for backdated or rounded starts.

entry_method.description: Config block to honor. Default timer.

cursor_mode.description: When entry_method is automated, resolve description from platforms.cursor.modes.<mode> instead of on_start.

confirm_overlap.description: Write even when the start falls inside an existing completed entry.

description.description: What you are working on. Overrides the description template.

issue_number.description: Forge issue number for description template.

issue_title.description: Forge issue title for description template.

label.description: Forge label for {label} in templates (after when_multiple_labels policy).

plan_title.description: Plan title for {planTitle} when cursor_mode is plan and description.from is template.

debug_title.description: Debug title for {debugTitle} when cursor_mode is debug and description.from is template.

tools.name: clockify_stop_timer
tools.description: Stops the currently running timer. Honors entry_method rounding (end only), include_seconds, and overlap.on_conflict. Pass runaway_stop true after the user chooses a runaway ceiling stop (end = start + stop_after_minutes, no stop rounding). Pass config_root as that repo's git toplevel when this MCP is user-scoped.

config_root.description: Absolute git toplevel of the repo that contains .clockify/config.yml. Resolve once per session with `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` from the working directory (open tabs are not required); reuse that string on later calls unless the repo or focused root changed. Do not pass a multi-root .code-workspace folder.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID. Defaults to scope.workspace_id from config.yml (required pin). Never the Clockify UI active workspace.

entry_method.description: Config block to honor. Default timer.

confirm_overlap.description: Write even when the stopped interval overlaps another entry.

apply_rounding.description: Override config rounding (default: use the entry_method block).

runaway_stop.description: When true and runaway.enabled, set end to start + stop_after_minutes (hard ceiling; skip stop rounding). Use only after AskQuestion for pastCeiling.

tools.name: clockify_create_time_entry
tools.description: Creates a completed time entry with explicit start and end (ISO-8601). Never rounds. entry_method selects manual vs automated description/overlap. When overlap.on_conflict is prompt, retry with confirm_overlap: true to stack intervals. Pass config_root as that repo's git toplevel when this MCP is user-scoped.

config_root.description: Absolute git toplevel of the repo that contains .clockify/config.yml. workspace_id.description: Workspace ID. Defaults to scope.workspace_id from config.yml (required pin). Never the Clockify UI active workspace.

entry_method.description: Config block to honor. Default manual.

confirm_overlap.description: Write even when the interval overlaps another entry.
